children: Industrial Logistics Properties Trust named Anthony Paula as chief financial officer and treasurer, bringing on board a vice president of its manager The RMR Group.
Paula's appointment takes effect Oct. 1, the company said Monday.
He succeeds Tiffany Sy, who resigned from her position with ILPT effective Sept. 30.  ILPT said Sy's resignation wasn't the result of any dispute with the company or RMR.
At RMR, an alternative asset management company, Paula is responsible for certain accounting, Securities and Exchange Commission reporting and corporate finance functions, ILPT said.
Paula is also vice president of Diversified Healthcare Trust, a role he will resign from in connection with his appointment at ILPT, the company said.
